mechanism: Normalize tilt angle (TC band, band 6 of training_features.tif) to [0,1] via 2nd-98th percentile. Select top 100,000 pixels within the 1px dilation ring of the catalogue (excluding catalogue pixels). Binary dot placement.
named_non_fault_mimic: Welded ash-flow tuff cooling joints produce sharp magnetic boundaries similar to faults but lack the systematic proximity to known fault zones. Mitigated by the ring constraint (only 1px from catalogue).
